title: The Silent Language of a Mother's Love
logline: A child of Sheka tells how their mother gave up her own comfort and dreams so her children could have the chances she never had, a love remembered every morning through her old coffee cup.
changelog: v1: drafted by the coding agent (Claude) from story/notes.md and DESIGN.md; narration to be checked by me (native speaker) after the first TTS draft.
v1: 'jebena' replaced by a physical description in prompts: FLUX.2 klein drew a plain clay vase for the word 'jebena' in the smoke test (EXPERIMENTS.md E01).

v1: the slow voice style made the narration 77 s and the film 92 s (over 90). A 'calm natural pace' retake was 12% shorter on 3 lines before the TTS free tier (10 requests/day) ran out. Kept the original take and capped pauses inside each line at 0.45 s in code instead: 77.4 s -> 67.9 s, no extra model calls (EXPERIMENTS.md E02-E04).
v1: s04 no_face_prompt rewritten: 'from behind and slightly to the side' still showed her profile and had her pouring coffee into a cooking pot (EXPERIMENTS.md E05).

v1: style reference sheet generated (4 seeds, chose 201: the most jebena-like pot). Conditioning keyframes on it was tested on s02 and s05 and made them worse (FLUX.2 klein pasted the table and pot into the forest, lost the dress), so use_style_reference stays false (EXPERIMENTS.md E07).

v1: mix gets a -10 dBFS pre-limiter and a -1.5 dBTP loudnorm ceiling: AAC export measured -14.04 LUFS / -1.76 dBTP, where -1 dBTP alone gave -0.77 dBTP after AAC and -1.5 alone gave -15.03 LUFS (EXPERIMENTS.md E09).

consent.note: Both false until recorded in ETHICS.md. While likeness_approved is false, character shots use no_face_prompt and the character reference sheet is not generated. While script_approved is false, every export carries a DRAFT mark.

style.style_block: warm cinematic film still, documentary realism, soft natural golden light, gentle film grain, muted earthy palette of coffee brown, forest green and cream, shallow depth of field, subject centred in the frame, no text, no letters
style.character_block: the mother: an Ethiopian woman in her forties with dark brown skin, a calm kind face, hair covered by a white cotton netela shawl, wearing a simple cream cotton dress with a thin green woven border

style.prompt: interior of a quiet rural Ethiopian home at dawn: mud-plastered walls, a low wooden table with an old slightly chipped white ceramic coffee cup and a round-bellied black clay coffee pot with a long narrow neck, a spout and a handle, a woven grass mat, soft window light

character.prompt: character reference sheet, the same woman shown twice side by side on a plain cream background: front view and three-quarter view, head and shoulders, neutral calm expression

voice.style: Amharic, spoken slowly and warmly, like a grown child remembering their mother with gratitude; gentle pauses between phrases

music.caption: tender instrumental underscore inspired by Ethiopian tizita mood, soft plucked krar-like lyre, warm low string pad, sparse and slow, no drums, no strong lead melody, gentle swell near the end, cinematic and nostalgic

end_card_lines: Made with AI: images, voice and music

shots.reason: Opens on the motif, the old coffee cup, so the ending can return to it; a quiet, intimate first feeling.
shots.image_prompt: extreme close-up of an old, slightly chipped white ceramic coffee cup on a worn wooden table at dawn, thin steam rising, a round-bellied black clay coffee pot with a long narrow neck and a spout softly out of focus behind it
shots.motion_prompt: steam rises slowly from the cup; the camera stays fixed

narration.am: በየማለዳው የእናቴ አሮጌ የቡና ስኒ ጸጥ ያለ ታሪክ ይነግረናል።
narration.en: Every morning, my mother's old coffee cup tells us a quiet story.

shots.music_cue: cue 1 starts: sparse plucked notes, very soft

shots.reason: Establishes where she came from: the green forests of Sheka, beautiful but hard.
shots.image_prompt: extreme wide establishing shot of misty green forested hills at sunrise in southwest Ethiopia, tall old trees, a few round thatched-roof huts in a small clearing, wild coffee shrubs in the foreground
shots.motion_prompt: mist drifts slowly across the hills; slow push-in

narration.am: እናቴ ያደገችው በሸካ ዞን፣ የኪ ወረዳ ውስጥ ነው፤ ኑሮ ከባድ፣ ዕድልም ጥቂት በነበረበት ቦታ።
narration.en: She grew up in Yeki, in Sheka Zone, where life was hard and chances were few.

shots.reason: Her childhood shown without a face: a girl carrying water alone, so we feel the hardship that shaped her.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot from behind of a young Ethiopian girl in a simple faded dress walking along a red earth path through dense green forest, carrying a clay water pot on her back, morning mist
shots.motion_prompt: the girl walks slowly away along the path; the camera stays fixed

narration.am: በዙሪያዋ ብዙ ችግር ቢኖርም፣ ታታሪ፣ አሳቢና ቆራጥ ሴት ሆና አደገች።
narration.en: Despite the hardship around her, she grew into a hardworking, caring and determined woman.

shots.reason: Introduces her as a mother at work before dawn; the responsibility that tested her.
shots.image_prompt: medium shot of the mother kneeling by a small charcoal stove at dawn inside a simple mud-walled home, pouring coffee from a round-bellied black clay coffee pot with a long narrow neck and a spout, warm firelight on her face, children asleep under blankets in the soft background
shots.no_face_prompt: medium shot of a woman seen from directly behind, her back to the camera so her face is not visible, kneeling on a woven mat by a small charcoal brazier at dawn inside a simple mud-walled home, a white cotton netela shawl over her head and shoulders, cream cotton dress with a thin green woven border, she holds a small round black clay coffee pot with a short spout over the glowing charcoal, small white handleless cups on a low tray beside her, children asleep under blankets in the soft background
shots.motion_prompt: she pours coffee slowly and steam rises; gentle push-in

narration.am: ልጆቿን የማሳደግ ኃላፊነት ስትወስድ፣ ችግሮች ጥንካሬዋን፣ ትዕግስቷንና ቆራጥነቷን ፈተኑ።
narration.en: When she took on raising her children, hardship tested her strength, patience and resolve.

shots.music_cue: cue 2: the string pad enters, slowly building

shots.reason: Sacrifice shown through action, not words: tired hands working late at night for her children.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of a woman's worn hands sewing a button onto a child's blue school uniform by the light of a small kerosene lamp at night, the sleeve of a cream cotton dress with a thin green woven border
shots.motion_prompt: her hands pull the thread slowly; the lamp flame flickers; the camera stays fixed

narration.am: ጊዜዋን፣ ምቾቷንና ብዙ የራሷን ሕልሞች ሠዋች፤
narration.en: She gave up her time, her comfort and many of her own dreams,

shots.reason: What her sacrifice bought: her children walking to school, toward the chances she never had.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot from behind of the mother standing in the doorway of a mud-walled house in the morning, watching three children in blue school uniforms walk away down a dirt road toward a distant school
shots.no_face_prompt: wide shot from directly behind of a woman seen only from the back, a white cotton netela shawl over her head and shoulders, cream cotton dress with a thin green woven border, standing in the doorway of a mud-walled house in the morning, watching three children in blue school uniforms walk away down a dirt road toward a distant school
shots.motion_prompt: the children walk slowly away down the road; the camera stays fixed

narration.en: so that we could have the chances she never had.

shots.reason: Love shown in everyday care: the family coffee ceremony she held together, warm and close.
shots.image_prompt: medium close-up of the mother pouring coffee into small white cups for her family around a low wooden table, warm lamplight, gentle smiles, faint incense smoke in the air
shots.no_face_prompt: medium close-up of a woman's hands and forearms in a cream cotton sleeve with a thin green woven border, pouring coffee from a round-bellied black clay coffee pot with a long narrow neck and a spout into small white cups on a low wooden table, children's hands reaching for the cups, warm lamplight, faint incense smoke, faces out of frame
shots.motion_prompt: she slowly pours coffee into a cup; warm light flickers; the camera stays fixed

narration.am: ፍቅሯ በቃል ብቻ አልተገለጸም፤ ስፍር ቁጥር በሌለው እንክብካቤ፣ ጽናትና መሥዋዕትነት ታየ።
narration.en: Her love was not only spoken; it showed in countless acts of care, endurance and sacrifice.

shots.music_cue: cue 3: the opening plucked theme returns

shots.reason: Present day: older hands hold the same cup; the motif returns and links her past to our present.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of an older Ethiopian woman's hands holding the same old, slightly chipped white ceramic coffee cup near a window, soft morning light, thin steam rising, the sleeve of a cream cotton dress with a thin green woven border
shots.motion_prompt: steam rises gently from the cup; slow push-in

narration.am: ዛሬ እናውቃለን፤ የእናት ፍቅር የሚለካው በምትናገረው ብቻ ሳይሆን በምትሰጠው፣ በምትታገሰውና በምታደርገው ነው።
narration.en: Today we know: a mother's love is measured not only by what she says, but by what she gives, endures and does.

shots.reason: Closing image of legacy: hands of every generation sharing coffee around her cup; the feeling we want to leave.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot of the hands of a family of different ages holding small coffee cups together around a wooden table in morning light, the old slightly chipped white cup at the centre, thin steam rising
shots.motion_prompt: steam rises slowly; the hands stay still; slow pull-out

narration.am: ጊዜ ቢያልፍም፣ ያስተማረችን እሴቶችና የከፈለችው መሥዋዕትነት የቤተሰባችን ማንነት ሆነው ለመጪው ትውልድ ይኖራሉ።
narration.en: Time passes, but her values and her sacrifice remain our family's identity, for the generations to come.
